title: EMP & Grid-Down Preparedness
description: Explains solar and man-made EMPs and what they realistically will and won't do, then shows how to build a Faraday cage from a trash can or ammo can and what to protect first. Covers the cascade of grid failure, living without electricity, a phased plan for the first 72 hours, and maintenance checks.
shortDescription: Solar vs. man-made EMPs, Faraday cages, and the first 72 hours without power
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
